tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a shell command and return output.

tools.name: edit-file
tools.description: Replace a string in a file. The old_string must be unique.

arguments.name: old_string
arguments.description: Exact string to replace (must be unique in file)

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern. Returns paths sorted by modification time.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Directory to search in (default: project root)

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents using regex pattern. Uses ripgrep if available.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

arguments.name: glob_filter
arguments.description: Limit search to files matching pattern (e.g., *.el)

tools.name: read-file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Returns lines with line numbers.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.description: Absolute path to the file to read

tools.name: write-file
tools.description: Write content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist.

result_contract.tool_results: text; errors are signaled or returned as Tool error: text by the execution wrapper
